title: as2 action
description: Sends the body to a trading partner by AS2 (RFC 4130): compressed, signed and encrypted as as2MessageStructure says, in a POST to the partner, and checks the receipt (MDN) in the response. The body goes on unchanged; the headers AS2-Message-Id, AS2-MDN-Disposition, AS2-MDN-Signed and http.status are set. Asynchronous receipts are not supported.

hostName.title: Host
hostName.description: Host name of the partner's AS2 server

targetPortNumber.title: Port
targetPortNumber.description: Port of the partner; https is used for 443 and 8443, and when sslContext is set, else http

port.title: Port (alias)
port.description: The same as targetPortNumber, which wins

requestUri.title: Request URI
requestUri.description: Path of the partner's AS2 endpoint, such as /as2/inbound

uri.title: URI (alias)
uri.description: The same as requestUri, which wins

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject of the message; a header subject of the message overrides it

ediMessageContentType.title: Content type
ediMessageContentType.description: Content type of the document, such as application/edifact or application/edi-x12; else messageContentType, else application/edifact

messageContentType.title: Content type (alias)
messageContentType.description: Used when ediMessageContentType is not set

as2MessageStructure.title: Structure
as2MessageStructure.description: PLAIN, SIGNED, ENCRYPTED, SIGNED_ENCRYPTED, PLAIN_COMPRESSED, SIGNED_COMPRESSED, ENCRYPTED_COMPRESSED or ENCRYPTED_COMPRESSED_SIGNED. Compressed first, then signed, then encrypted

signingAlgorithm.title: Signing algorithm
signingAlgorithm.description: SHA1WITHRSA, SHA256WITHRSA, SHA384WITHRSA or SHA512WITHRSA; it is also the digest of the receipt's integrity check

certificateForSigning.title: Signing key
certificateForSigning.description: The private key and certificate this side signs with: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

certificateForEncrypt.title: Partner certificate
certificateForEncrypt.description: The partner's certificate, to encrypt for; it also decides whom a signed receipt must be from: PEM text, the address (http:// or https://) of PEM, or the path of a PEM file or PKCS#12 keystore (opened with password)

password.title: Keystore password
password.description: Password of a PKCS#12 keystore in certificateForSigning or certificateForEncrypt

keyAlias.title: Key alias
keyAlias.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

sslContext.title: SSL context
sslContext.description: Accepted for compatibility: it selects https. The trust store options are what trusts the partner's certificate

mdn.title: Receipt
mdn.description: sync: ask for a receipt and fail if it is missing, reports a problem or has another integrity check; none: do not ask

dispositionNotificationTo.title: Receipt address
dispositionNotificationTo.description: Value of Disposition-Notification-To; as2From if empty

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds a call may take, and the fetch of a key from an address

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust for https calls (also to fetch keys); "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
